# Security Policy

## Supported Versions
Security updates are actively applied to the main branch of all production repositories.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| Main    | :white_check_mark: |
| Legacy  | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within any of my public or open-source repositories, please **do not** disclose it publicly via GitHub Issues.

Instead, please send an email to **ramalokom@outlook.com**.

I take security seriously and will endeavor to acknowledge the report within 48 hours and work on a fix promptly. Please include:
- The name of the repository.
- A description of the vulnerability.
- Steps to reproduce the issue.
- Any potential impact.
